'''November 2000 Huntsville tournament (25 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL on 25 November 2000. [[Andy McClure]] won it. It is known from Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1496">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-huntsville-al-11-25-00d1496/ huntsville-al-11-25-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 26 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-26-huntsville-al-11-25-00d1496/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
